title: Research It So I Don't Have To
description: Researches something thoroughly, then gives you only what matters: what changed the answer, the tradeoffs, the open questions and what to do next.
promise: Research something thoroughly without reading an encyclopedia afterward.
what_it_does: It does the research, then puts the answer in this order:
when_to_use: You need to understand something well enough to decide, and you don't have six hours.
You're comparing things to buy, book or sign up for.
what_to_give_it: What you're going to do with the answer.
Anything you already know or already ruled out.
what_you_get: A short answer with the tradeoffs, not a report.
The questions nobody could answer yet.
